titulo.alumno: Agreement in reported narration: who said what and when

intro: In long narratives with several reported contributions, the coherence of the story depends on clearly identifying who is speaking, to whom they are speaking and what chronological order links the events.

texto: **Simultaneity with the main verb**: it is expressed with the imperfect (**Disse che era contento**, he said he was happy).
**Anteriority**: it is expressed with the pluperfect (**Spiegò che aveva perso le chiavi**, he explained that he had lost the keys).
**Posteriority (future in the past)**: it is formulated with the past conditional (**Promise che avrebbe chiamato**, he promised that he would call).

filas.texto: Disse che non poteva venire perché lavorava.
Disse che aveva già avvisato tutti i colleghi.
Disse che sarebbe arrivato con il treno successivo.

piezas.titulo: A message on the answering machine

frases.estudio: C'è un messaggio urgente di Lorenzo nella segreteria telefonica dell'ufficio.
frases.alumno: There is an urgent message from Lorenzo on the office answering machine.
analisis: from Lorenzo on the answering machine

frases.estudio: Ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo per la riunione delle tre perché il treno era bloccato.
frases.alumno: He said he would not make it on time for the three o'clock meeting because the train was blocked.
analisis: ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo
he said he would not make it on time

frases.estudio: Ha precisato se si sarebbe collegato via internet?
frases.alumno: Did he clarify whether he would connect via the internet?
analisis: he would connect via the internet

frases.estudio: Sì, ha promesso che ci avrebbe inviato una notifica appena possibile.
frases.alumno: Yes, he promised that he would send us a notification as soon as possible.
analisis: he would send us a notification

pregunta.texto: Why does Claudia say «ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo»?

opciones.texto: Because it expresses a posteriority projected into the future from a past moment.
opciones.explicacion: In past indirect style the future is expressed by means of the past conditional.

opciones.texto: Because Lorenzo states with absolute certainty that he already attended the meeting.
opciones.explicacion: It precisely communicates that he will not be able to attend in person.

opciones.texto: Because the train arrived half an hour early at the station.
opciones.explicacion: The train was stopped because of a blocked line.

frase.texto: Lorenzo ha promesso che ci ___ un messaggio appena possibile.

opciones.explicacion: Past conditional of «inviare» with the auxiliary avere in the third person singular.
It is the simple future indicative (valid only if the main verb is in the present).
It is the pluperfect (it would mark a completed anteriority).

pregunta.texto: What complex structure does this question present?

frase.texto: Ha precisato se si sarebbe collegato via internet per la riunione.

opciones.texto: An indirect question introduced by «se» with the future in the past («si sarebbe collegato»).
opciones.explicacion: It combines the indirect question with the temporal projection of the compound conditional.

opciones.texto: A firm military order requiring all computers to be switched off.
opciones.explicacion: It raises the question of the possibility of an online connection.

opciones.texto: An absolute certainty that the internet service is broken.
opciones.explicacion: It enquires about the intention to take part digitally.

frase.texto: Lorenzo ha detto che avrebbe chiamato subito dopo la riunione

piezas.traduccion: Lorenzo said he would call straight after the meeting.
piezas.explicacion: Future in the past with the past conditional after a verb of saying.

pregunta.texto: What does the sentence «il treno era bloccato» indicate in Claudia's account?

opciones.texto: A simultaneous circumstance in the past that justifies Lorenzo's delay.
opciones.explicacion: The imperfect describes the lasting background state that caused the unforeseen event.

opciones.texto: An event that will happen the following week if it snows in the mountains.
opciones.explicacion: It is the justification at the time of the phone call.

opciones.texto: An order for the passengers to get off the carriages.
opciones.explicacion: It notes the blocking of the train.

frase.texto: I colleghi mi hanno confermato che la direttrice ___ già partita per Milano.

opciones.explicacion: Pluperfect with the auxiliary essere agreeing in the feminine singular: «era già partita».
It is the simple past historic.
The conditional would mark future posteriority, not a previous completed fact.

pregunta.texto: What function does the pronoun «ci» have in this sentence?

frase.texto: Ha promesso che ci avrebbe inviato una notifica appena possibile.

opciones.texto: It works as an indirect object: «to us» he would send a notification.
opciones.explicacion: «Ci» replaces the group of colleagues waiting for the notice.

opciones.texto: It works as a locative particle meaning «in that place».
opciones.explicacion: It is not locative but the dative personal pronoun of the first person plural.

opciones.texto: It works as a reflexive pronoun of the third person.
